_readme: Registry of trips. Each `file` lives in its own folder and every asset path inside it is relative to that folder, so adding a trip is dropping in one directory. The departures board on the landing page uses `month`, `boardLabel` (short — one word reads best in the column) and `status` (boarding | ontime | closed).
_boardExtrasNote: Rows shown above the real trips on the departures board. Trips that have been and gone, so they have no file and nothing to link to — set dressing that makes the board look like it has a history. They turn like any other row.
